'''AlphaBlue''' published constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]].
The titles of both decks match DeckTech decks posted in 2001 by [[John Anderson]] ([[John Anderson those green men blowed up that bunker again|those green men blowed up that bunker again]] and [[John Anderson RogueBlitzkreig EBO|RogueBlitzkreig EBO]]), who signed his DeckTech tournament reports in 2001–2002 as John "Alpha Blue" Anderson.<ref>[[John Anderson Atlanta GA 1-5-02 Galatic Quest (tournament report)]] and [[John Anderson Atlanta Georgia 10-27-01 Pre-Release (tournament report)]] (DeckTech bylines).</ref> {{Mystery|question=Is AlphaBlue the same person as John "puck71" Anderson|section=John Anderson of Atlanta and John Anderson of Minnesota: one person or two?}}

== Decklists ==

* [[AlphaBlue Those Little Green Men Blew Up The Bunker, Again! (RST)]] (LS, 9 December 2001)

* [[AlphaBlue Rogue: Blitzkrieg EBO]] (LS, 9 December 2001)
